verdict.rationale: Grammar-constrained or JSON-structured output is a fair axis for a local LLM runtime and server, so the story applies. Nothing in the pack documents GBNF grammars, JSON schema constraints, or structured-output options. The server CLI reference [llamafile-docs-9] lists only generic server, API, Web UI and sandbox options. The llama.cpp Web UI mention [llamafile-docs-5] is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.
